structured.approach: I loaded the requirement-steps procedure for REQ-02, then read the four contracted inputs: feat.prebacklog, feat.intake, org.routing_map and org.architecture. I also read the organisation-level routing map named in the brief. To check for duplicates, I read every requirement file in hobasa-agentic-sdlc/requirements/, which stood in for the Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board because neither was available. I classified the entry by category (New Feature), qualifier (customer-visible, not Technical Only) and a technical sub-category per change request, each mapped to its routing owner. I compared each related item and decided whether to merge it. Nothing was merged. The sequencing overlaps are listed as non-blocking open questions. I did not run the verifier subagent. I checked the claims and numbers myself against the files I read and corrected one wording about ZD-48377. Shell use is blocked for this step (G9), so I read every file with Read.

claims.text: FEAT-ZD-48600 is classified as New Feature; the source file records expected_type New Feature and the ticket asks only for new functions, a new optional feed column and a new optional argument.

The entry is not Technical Only, because CR-6 adds a new portal view (renderOverdueRisk) that AP managers see. RETRO-2026-19 shows the Technical Only label used for an item with no customer-visible change.

Technical sub-categories: CR-1 and CR-2 data engineering (ap_pipeline), CR-3 and CR-4 data science (ap_forecast), CR-5 backend (ap_aging), CR-6 frontend (ap_portal), CR-7 end-to-end testing across all four.

Impacted repositories: ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging, ap_portal. The feature routing map routes each to a coding agent and the end-to-end tests to the Testing Agent. The organisation-level routing map lists only ap_aging.
No duplicate was found, so nothing was merged. ZD-48211 and ZD-48501 share the overdue rule (unpaid, more than 30 days past due) with CR-5, but each asks for a different function or view.
ZD-48470 adds currency to the vendor feed (v2). This entry's feed v3 column list holds paid_date but not currency.
PROV-ACME-2026-11 replaces acme-text-2 with acme-text-3 and adds a system field to the explanation request that CR-4 also changes.
ZD-48377 reports an invoice exactly 30 days past due landing in the 31-60 bucket instead of 1-30. CR-5 uses the same more-than-30-days boundary, and L-007 requires testing that boundary explicitly.
The architecture requires keeping every existing signature and adding new functions.

open_questions: OQ-A: Should ap_aging have one shared overdue predicate (unpaid, more than 30 days past due) for ZD-48211, ZD-48501 and CR-5, and in which order should they be built?
OQ-B: Should ZD-48470 (feed v2, currency) land before this entry's feed change, and should feed v3 include currency? Its column list in the source file does not.
OQ-C: PROV-ACME-2026-11 changes the model and adds a system field to the same explanation request as CR-4. Which lands first?
OQ-D: Should the ZD-48377 boundary fix land before CR-5? It depends on whether the defect is in days_past_due or bucket_for.
OQ-E: The Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board were not available; the duplicate check covered only the repository's requirement files (as OQ-1 in feat.prebacklog).
structured.summary: I wrote feat.classification for FEAT-ZD-48600. The entry is a New Feature and is customer-visible, not Technical Only. Each change request has a technical sub-category and routing owner. The impacted repositories are ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging and ap_portal. No duplicates were merged. Five related items (ZD-48211, ZD-48501, ZD-48470, PROV-ACME-2026-11 and ZD-48377) are kept separate and raised as non-blocking sequencing questions. No ticket was created in an external system; the file holds the new ticket content.
